en: Shelly: Ahaha! You again? The boss told me to keep anybody who came this far busy. And you'll keep me amused!
Shelly: Not amused at all... Go on, then. You'll see the boss's dream come true with your own eyes.
Team Aqua Grunt: The deeper we go, the hotter it gets. Is this place under a volcano?
Team Aqua Grunt: I'm not sweating because I lost. It's the heat.
